players.name: Al Horford
players.note: Horford (back) is out for Wednesday's game against the Mavericks, but will play Thursday against the Grizzlies, Nick Friedell of The Athletic reports.

players.name: Isaiah Stewart
players.note: Stewart (illness) won't play Wednesday against the Cavs.

players.name: GG Jackson
players.note: Jackson underwent a procedure Wednesday to repair a broken fifth metatarsal in his left foot. He is expected to recover fully and will be re-evaluated in approximately three months.

players.name: Ousmane Dieng
